person.name: Muhammad Uzair
person.line: I build AI that people talk to.
person.summary: Five years in data science and machine learning, the last three putting language models into products. Currently Aida, an AI financial adviser, where the answers have to be right as well as fast. I like problems where the model is only half the job; the rest is making it quick, keeping the data honest, and getting it into people’s hands.

facts: Based in the UK and open to relocation.
Speaks English fluently; Urdu and Pashto are native languages.
Five years in data science and machine learning, the last three putting language models into products.

roles.title: AI Engineer
roles.context: Aida is an AI financial adviser. I’m responsible for the parts of it that understand what a user says, remember it, and use it in later conversations.

points.title: Aida’s chat agent
points.text: Own the language-model agent behind Aida’s chat: tool selection, conversation flow, and how facts a user shares are captured and reused.

points.title: Single-call extraction
points.text: Replaced a multi-call extraction loop with a single-call design that is markedly faster, with no loss in accuracy.

points.title: Tool selection step
points.text: Designed the step that decides which tools the model sees for each message, so it picks the right one far more often.

points.title: Prompt caching
points.text: Introduced prompt caching across all model calls by separating the fixed and per-turn parts of each prompt.

points.title: Agent tool contracts
points.text: Set the patterns the team builds agent tools against: a typed contract per tool, structured JSON output per model call, and one place that defines what each tool needs before it can run.

points.title: Guarded financial data writes
points.text: Designed how the agent reads and writes financial data: typed profile writes behind a confidence threshold, tools gated on what the user’s accounts contain, and no unvalidated writes from the model.

points.title: Per-turn context
points.text: Own what the model sees each turn (history, rolling summary, user profile) so accuracy holds as conversations grow.

points.title: Model routing and failover
points.text: Routed models per task, a small model for classification and tool selection and a larger one for the reply, with automatic failover; migrated services between model generations without regressions.

points.title: Agent regression tests
points.text: Built automated regression testing for the agent: fixed conversation datasets with expected tool calls and outputs, run on every prompt, tool and model change.

points.title: Prompt-assembly visualiser
points.text: Built a prompt-assembly visualiser that shows exactly what the model saw on any turn.

roles.title: Full Stack Data Scientist
roles.context: Data science and backend work for a vehicle fleet business: research, proof-of-concept builds and analytics for internal teams.

points.title: Conversational analytics
points.text: Developed and deployed conversational data-visualisation services using LLMs and Dash, so non-technical users could query real-time analytics in plain language.

points.title: AI research briefs
points.text: Evaluated new AI tools and wrote research briefs that senior leadership used to decide what to invest in.

points.title: Fleet utilisation system
points.text: Built a vehicle utilisation and monitoring system that cut manual reporting by 70%.

points.title: Statistical modelling
points.text: Ran statistical modelling and exploratory analysis across MSSQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB.

points.title: MSSQL to PostgreSQL migration
points.text: Migrated databases from MSSQL to PostgreSQL with no data loss, improving query performance.

points.title: CI/CD pipelines
points.text: Managed deployment pipelines with CircleCI and Docker, reducing release times.

roles.title: Co-founder
roles.context: A start-up building a web product that helped people talk through personal issues from both an emotional and a rational perspective. I owned the backend and deployment in a small team; we paused in late 2023 when funding ran out.

points.title: Flask APIs on Fargate
points.text: Built Flask REST APIs backed by MongoDB and deployed them on AWS Fargate.

points.title: Open-source LLM features
points.text: Used open-source language models for the product’s AI features, and curated the datasets behind them.

points.title: RAG with Qdrant and Pinecone
points.text: Built retrieval-augmented generation with Qdrant and Pinecone, reducing hallucinations.

points.title: Containerised deploys
points.text: Containerised the services with Docker and deployed with AWS CDK and Fargate, with SSL for HTTPS.

roles.title: Data Scientist
roles.context: Python, machine learning and deep learning to speed up data collection and research at an early-stage start-up.

points.title: Web scraper, 500k records
points.text: Developed a Python web scraper that collected over half a million descriptions and stock quotes.

points.title: ML models, 90%+ accuracy
points.text: Designed and implemented machine-learning models on my own, reaching over 90% accuracy.

points.title: CNN image models
points.text: Tested image-processing models using CNN architectures (VGG-16, Inception).

roles.title: System Support Engineer
roles.context: Technical support and IT services for clients, specialising in Oracle databases and Linux systems.

points.title: Oracle and Linux admin
points.text: Set up, administered and tuned Oracle RDBMS and Linux systems for client environments.

points.title: Backup and recovery
points.text: Ran database backup and recovery using RMAN and Data Pump.

education.note: Thesis: NLP sentiment analysis using deep learning and transfer learning to work around limited training data.
